# BhoomiQ
> AI-powered property portfolio management for Indian families

BhoomiQ is a free SaaS platform that helps Indian families manage 5 to 100+ properties from a single dashboard. It replaces Excel spreadsheets and paper records with an intelligent, AI-powered system designed specifically for Indian property owners.

## Features
- AI-powered utility bill scanning (UGVCL, Torrent Power, AMC, Adani Gas, GWSSB)
- Rental income tracking by property, tenant, and month
- Property analytics with rental yield and ROI calculations
- Excel/CSV import with automatic multi-unit building detection and field mapping
- Bank statement import with AI transaction extraction and property matching
- Property document vault with digital storage
- Interactive property map with geocoding
- Registration details tracking (stamp duty, dastavej number, ownership splits)
- Sale tracking with profit/loss calculation
- Remarks/activity timeline per property
- Rent collection tracker with bulk recording
- Property comparison (side-by-side metrics)
- Tenant directory

## Key Facts
- Free to start, web-based progressive web app (works on any device)
- Built with Next.js, deployed on Vercel
- AI powered by Google Gemini 2.0 Flash via Vercel AI SDK
- Supports Indian utility providers: UGVCL, Torrent Power, AMC, Adani Gas, GWSSB
- Handles Indian number formats (lakhs, crores), dates (DD/MM/YYYY), and currency (₹)
- Excel import migrates existing property portfolios in under 5 minutes
- Tracks portfolio value, rental yields, and per-property profitability
- Designed for families in Ahmedabad, Gujarat and across India
